title: Commit metadata to base branch
description:
## Objective
.tick/ and .devmeta/ change during orchestration and are not in the iteration PR. Commit them directly to the base branch.

## Implementation
1. `git add .tick/ .devmeta/`
2. `git status --short` — verify only metadata files are staged.
3. Commit as 'Update .tick/ and .devmeta/ metadata for iteration 01.1'.

## Tests
`git status --short` is clean afterwards.
acceptance_criteria: working tree clean on the base branch
closed_reason: metadata committed to base branch; working tree clean
